bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'AUDIT_STAGE=RUNTIME_LOCATOR\n'
printf 'REPO_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
printf 'FILE_MATCHES_BEGIN\n'
find . -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -iname '*topic*' -o -iname '*pin*' -o -iname '*posting*' -o -iname '*menu*' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' | head -n 35 | cut -c 1-140
printf 'FILE_MATCHES_END\n'
printf 'SERVICE_MATCHES_BEGIN\n'
systemctl --user list-units --type=service --no-pager --plain 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|gateapp|telegram|userbot' | head -n 12 | cut -c1-130 || true
printf 'SERVICE_MATCHES_END\n'
printf 'DOCKER_MATCHES_BEGIN\n'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'bot|gay|gate|telegram' | head -n 15 || true
printf 'DOCKER_MATCHES_END\n'
printf 'PARENT_DIRS_BEGIN\n'
find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -not -path '*/.git*' | head -n 24
printf 'PARENT_DIRS_END\n'
